2026-08-06.label: Thursday
2026-08-06.consensus: Very humid and mostly cloudy with meaningful, intermittently timed shower/thunderstorm risk throughout the golf window. Thursday is the riskiest day for disruption. Lightning can require leaving the course.

nws_daily.summary: Showers and thunderstorms likely before 2 PM; another likely period 3-5 PM; 0.10-0.25 inch possible; SSW wind 2-7 mph.

cross_checks.accuweather: 71-79 F, RealFeel 75-87 F, 15-51% hourly precipitation; thunderstorms shown at 4 PM; daily 55% and about two rain hours.
cross_checks.gfs: 71-81 F, 6-25% precipitation, about 0.03 inch, gusts up to 25 mph.

2026-08-07.label: Friday
2026-08-07.consensus: Warm, muggy, and mostly cloudy with scattered shower/thunderstorm risk. Timing is uncertain; risk persists through the golf window and trends somewhat higher in the afternoon in NWS/AccuWeather. Not a guaranteed washout.

nws_daily.summary: Chance of showers and thunderstorms, mostly cloudy, SSW wind 1-6 mph, less than 0.10 inch daytime rainfall expected.

cross_checks.accuweather: 71-83 F, RealFeel 77-92 F, 19-47% hourly precipitation; daily 55% and about two rain hours.

2026-08-08.label: Saturday
2026-08-08.consensus: Best golfing day of the three. A morning or isolated early-afternoon shower remains possible, then generally partly to mostly sunny, warm, and humid. Most guidance is dry after about 2 PM.

nws_daily.summary: Slight shower chance before 8 AM and slight shower/thunderstorm chance 8 AM-2 PM; partly sunny; WSW wind near 7 mph.

nws_9am_to_5pm.hourly_condition: Isolated showers/thunderstorms through 1 PM, then mostly sunny

cross_checks.accuweather: 72-85 F, RealFeel 76-93 F; a shower at 9 AM (51%) and possible shower at 2 PM (42%), otherwise 17-47%; daily 55% but only about one rain hour.

evaluation_rules.date_accuracy: Must interpret next three days as Thu Aug 6, Fri Aug 7, and Sat Aug 8, 2026. A shifted three-day window is a major error.
evaluation_rules.location_accuracy: Must resolve Purdue golf courses to the Birck Boilermaker Golf Complex in West Lafayette, Indiana, not Purdue Fort Wayne or another Purdue location.
evaluation_rules.weather_accuracy: Temperatures within roughly 4 F of the NWS/consensus ranges are acceptable. The response must communicate meaningful thunderstorm risk Thursday, continued but uncertain storm risk Friday, and Saturday as the best/mostly drier day with a residual early shower risk.
evaluation_rules.uncertainty: Exact thunderstorm timing varies materially across NWS, GFS, ECMWF, ICON, and AccuWeather. Confidently claiming a dry Thursday/Friday or an all-day washout is inaccurate.
evaluation_rules.golf_safety: A strong answer warns that lightning means leaving the course and suggests checking radar/alerts shortly before tee time.
evaluation_rules.tool_calling: The model should proactively use current web/weather sources. Fabricating current conditions without a tool call is a failure.
evaluation_rules.readability: Prefer a compact day-by-day 9 AM-5 PM breakdown with temperature trend, rain/storm risk, wind/humidity or feels-like, and a clear best-day conclusion.
